count.heading: The family of Virgil Pokorny and Pat Hulse
count.note: The book lists two children under this heading, but labels them "Children of Pat Hulse:" (Laurie, b. 1967, and Mike, b. 1969, born before Virgil and Pat married in 1983). They are modelled in a one-parent family of Pat Hulse (pat-hulse-children), not as Virgil's children, so virgil1944-pat has 0 children and pat-hulse-children has the printed 2.
